grammar.title: 一般现在时 vs 现在进行时
grammar.structure: 一般现在时：主语 + 动词原形/单三；现在进行时：主语 + be (am/is/are) + 现在分词
grammar.definition: 一般现在时表示一般的、不断重复的习惯动作或永久情况（常与 usually/always/often/sometimes/every day 连用）；现在进行时表示说话时正在发生、尚未完成的暂时动作（常与 now/at the moment/today/this morning/this afternoon/this evening/tonight 连用）。进行时只用于动作动词，状态动词（like/want/know 等）不可用进行时。
grammar.usage: We usually watch television at night. But we are listening to the stereo tonight.

examples.en: The children go to school by car every day, but today they are going on foot.
examples.zh: 孩子们每天乘车上学，但今天正步行。

examples.en: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but he is reading a book tonight.
examples.zh: 索耶先生通常看报，但今晚正在读书。

grammar.title: 非动作动词（状态动词）不用进行时
grammar.structure: like / want / know / understand 等 + 不用 be + -ing
grammar.definition: like, want, know, love, belong 等表示状态、心理、拥有的动词不是动作动词，不能用于进行时态，只能说 I like / We know，不能说 I am liking / We are knowing。
grammar.usage: I know the answer. / She wants some water.

grammar.title: 交通方式 by car / on foot
grammar.structure: by + 交通工具（无冠词）；on foot
grammar.definition: by 表示「乘坐（某种交通工具）」，须与动词连用，表交通工具的名词前不加冠词（by car/bus/plane/sea/boat）；「步行」用 on foot，foot 用单数且加 on。
grammar.usage: They go to school by car. / They are going on foot today.

examples.en: The children go to school by car every day.
examples.zh: 孩子们每天乘汽车上学。

examples.en: today, they are going to school on foot.

patterns.pattern: It is + 时间. + 主语 usually + 动词..., but + 主语 + be动词 + 动词-ing + 时间.

original.en: It is four o'clock. Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room. But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
original.zh: 现在是四点。索耶太太通常在客厅喝茶。但今天下午她在花园里喝茶。

imitations.en: It is seven o'clock. Tom usually eats dinner at home. But tonight, he is eating dinner at a restaurant.
imitations.zh: 现在是七点。汤姆通常在家吃晚饭。但今晚他在餐厅吃晚饭。

imitations.en: It is nine o'clock. Lisa usually sleeps early, but tonight she is watching TV.
imitations.zh: 现在是九点。莉莎通常早睡，但今晚她在看电视。

patterns.pattern: At the moment, 主语 + be动词 + 动词-ing...

original.en: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
original.zh: 此刻，他们正在花园里玩耍。

imitations.en: At the moment, she is reading a book.
At the moment, he is cooking dinner.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + usually + 动词..., but + 主语 + be动词 + not + 动词-ing...

original.en: In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
original.zh: 晚上，孩子们通常做家庭作业，但今晚他们没在做家庭作业。

imitations.en: Usually, I watch TV in the evening, but today I am not watching TV.
imitations.zh: 通常我晚上看电视，但今天我没在看。

imitations.en: He usually works late, but today he is not working.
imitations.zh: 他通常工作到很晚，但今天他没在工作。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + usually + 动词原形/三单形式 + 时间状语. But + 主语 + be动词 + 动词-ing + tonight/today/this...

original.en: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night. But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.
original.zh: 索耶先生通常在晚上看报纸。但今晚他没在看报纸。

imitations.en: I usually drink coffee in the morning. But this morning I am drinking tea.
imitations.zh: 我通常早上喝咖啡。但今天早上我在喝茶。

imitations.en: She usually wears a dress, but today she is wearing trousers.
imitations.zh: 她通常穿连衣裙，但今天她穿着裤子。

lines.en: It is eight o'clock. The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.
lines.zh: 现在是8点钟。孩子们每天都乘小汽车去上学，而今天，他们正步行上学。

lines.en: It is ten o'clock. Mrs Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning, but this morning, she is going to the shops.
lines.zh: 现在是10点钟。上午，索耶夫人通常是呆在家里的，但今天上午，她正去商店买东西。

lines.en: It is four o'clock. In the afternoon, Mrs Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living-room, but this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
lines.zh: 现在是4点钟。下午，索耶夫人通常是在客厅里喝茶，但今天下午，她正在花园里喝茶。

lines.en: It is six o'clock. In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework. At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
lines.zh: 现在是6点钟。晚上，孩子们通常是做作业，而今天晚上，他们没做作业。此刻，他们正在花园里玩。

lines.en: It is nine o'clock. Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night, but he is not reading his newspaper tonight. At the moment, he is reading an interesting book.
lines.zh: 现在是9点钟。索耶先生通常是在晚上看报，但今天晚上他没看报。此刻，他正在看一本有趣的书。

drill.q: What does he / she / they usually do (at time)? / What is he / she / they doing (this time)?
drill.zh: ……平时（在某时间）通常做什么？/……（这个时间）正在做什么？（对照一般现在时与现在进行时）

slots.en: she — in the morning — drinks tea / is drinking coffee
slots.zh: 她 — 上午 — 喝茶 / 正在喝咖啡

slots.en: they — in the afternoon — play in the garden / are swimming in the river
slots.zh: 他们 — 下午 — 在花园玩 / 正在河里游泳

slots.en: you — in the evening — cook a meal / are reading a book
slots.zh: 你 — 晚上 — 做饭 / 正在读书

slots.en: you — at night — watch television / are listening to the stereo
slots.zh: 你们 — 夜里 — 看电视 / 正在听立体声

answers: What does she usually do in the morning? She usually drinks tea. What is she doing this morning? She is drinking coffee.
What do they usually do in the afternoon? They usually play in the garden. What are they doing this afternoon? They are swimming in the river.

title: An unusual day / What is he doing tonight?
subtitle: 不平常的一天 / 他今晚正在做什么？

lead.question: 平时你乘汽车上学，今天却步行——你会用英语把「平时怎样」和「今天此刻正在怎样」对照着说出来吗？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象索耶家「不平常的一天」：平时孩子们乘汽车上学，今天却步行；平时夫人上午在家，今天却去商店；平时下午在客厅喝茶，今天却在花园里喝；平时晚上做作业，今天却在玩；平时先生夜里看报，今天却在读一本有趣的书。课文把「一般现在时（习惯/永久）」和「现在进行时（此刻/暂时）」并排对照——关键是时间词：usually / every day 配一般现在时，today / this morning / this afternoon / at the moment / tonight 配现在进行时。第 58 课把 What does he usually do? 与 What is he doing? 对照操练。
goals: 能用一般现在时描述习惯/永久动作，用现在进行时描述此刻/暂时动作
能就同一主体做「平时做 X，但此刻正在做 Y」的对照
掌握 by car / on foot 等交通方式表达（名词前无冠词）
能用 What is he/she doing (this time)? 询问此刻正在发生的动作
lead.summary: 第 57 课以五个整点时刻展现索耶家「不平常的一天」：8点孩子平时乘车今天步行；10点夫人平时上午在家今天去商店；4点夫人平时客厅喝茶今天花园里喝；6点孩子平时做作业今天在花园玩；9点先生平时看报今晚读有趣的书。全课把一般现在时与现在进行时对照。第 58 课用 What does she usually do …? / What is she doing this morning? 把喝咖啡、河里游泳、做饭、听立体声等活动逐一对照操练。
lead.tips: ① 一般现在时表习惯/永久，配 usually/every day；现在进行时表此刻/暂时，配 now/at the moment/today/this morning/this afternoon/this evening/tonight；② 对照句型：He usually reads …, but he is not reading … tonight；③ by car/bus/plane 表交通方式，名词前无冠词；on foot 步行；④ 非动作动词（like/want/know 等）不能用进行时；⑤ at the moment = 此刻、现在。

questions.q: What is Mr. Sawyer doing tonight?
questions.zh: 索耶先生今晚正在做什么？
questions.a: He is reading an interesting book.
questions.aZh: 他正在读一本有趣的书。
questions.hint: 听 he is not reading his newspaper tonight. At the moment, he is reading an interesting book.

questions.q: How do the children usually go to school, and how are they going today?
questions.zh: 孩子们平时怎么上学，今天怎么去？
questions.a: They go to school by car every day, but today they are going to school on foot.
questions.aZh: 他们每天乘汽车上学，但今天正步行上学。
questions.hint: by car every day / on foot today

questions.q: Where is Mrs Sawyer drinking tea this afternoon?
questions.zh: 今天下午索耶夫人在哪儿喝茶？
questions.hint: this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden（平时在客厅 living-room）。

questions.q: What are the children doing at the moment this evening?
questions.zh: 今天傍晚此刻孩子们正在做什么？
questions.a: They are playing in the garden.
questions.hint: they are not doing their homework … they are playing in the garden

questions.q: Why does the text use both 'usually/go' and 'today/are going' for the same people?
questions.zh: 为什么同一家人，课文既用 usually/go 又用 today/are going？
questions.a: The simple present (go/usually) describes habitual, permanent routines; the present continuous (are going/today, at the moment, tonight) describes an action happening right now, a temporary change from the routine. Putting them side by side highlights 'an unusual day'.
questions.aZh: 一般现在时讲习惯/永久动作，现在进行时讲此刻正在发生、暂时打破常规的动作；并排突出「不平常的一天」。
questions.hint: 习惯 vs 此刻正在发生。

questions.q: What does she usually do in the morning? She usually drinks tea. What is she doing this morning? She is drinking coffee.
questions.zh: 第 58 课操练：What does … usually do (at time)? / What is … doing (this time)? 对照一般现在时与现在进行时。
questions.a: What do they usually do in the afternoon? They usually play in the garden. What are they doing this afternoon? They are swimming in the river.
questions.aZh: 他们下午通常做什么？他们通常在花园玩。他们今天下午正在河里游泳。
questions.hint: usually 配一般现在时，this … 配现在进行时。

meanings.usage: 表示整点，与基数词连用
go to the shops 逛商店/买东西

examples.en: She is going to the shops.

meanings.usage: at the moment 此刻、现在

examples.en: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
examples.zh: 此刻，他们正在花园里玩。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他们正步行上学。
exercises.a: They are going to school on foot.
exercises.note: 现在进行时 be + going；on foot 步行。

exercises.q: 第 58 课：She usually drinks tea in the morning, but this morning, she ___ (drink) coffee.
exercises.note: this morning 表此刻，用现在进行时 is drinking。

exercises.q: 汉译英：此刻，他们正在花园里玩。
exercises.a: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
exercises.note: at the moment 此刻，配现在进行时。

exercises.q: 判断：I like music. 能否说 I am liking music? 为什么？
exercises.a: 不能。like 是非动作动词（状态动词），不用于进行时态，只能用 I like music.
exercises.note: like/want/know 等状态动词不用进行时。

exercises.q: 第 58 课：What are they doing this afternoon? — They ___ (swim) in the river.
exercises.note: this afternoon 配现在进行时 are swimming。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他正在看一本有趣的书。
exercises.a: He is reading an interesting book.
exercises.note: 现在进行时；interesting 形容词修饰 book。

exercises.q: 第 58 课：What do you usually do at night? — We usually ___ (watch) television at night.
exercises.note: usually 表习惯，用一般现在时原形 watch（主语 we）。

quiz.q: They are going to school on foot. 中的 on foot 意思是：
quiz.note: on foot 固定搭配，意为「步行」。
一般现在时表习惯、规律、永恒事实。

options: 此刻正在发生、暂时的动作
quiz.note: 现在进行时表说话时正在发生、未完成的暂时动作。

quiz.q: 关于 I know him. 下列说法正确：
options: 不能用于进行时（know 是非动作动词）
能说 I am knowing him
quiz.note: know/like/want 等状态动词不用进行时。

quiz.q: He is reading an interesting book. 中的 interesting 是：
by car 中 car 前：
quiz.note: by + 交通工具，名词前无冠词（by car/bus/plane）。
